title: Tunisian column inscription of the Canaanites who fled Joshua
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Tunisian column inscription of the Canaanites who fled Joshua, about antiquity at Tunisia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was a column that had a an inscription and the inscription read, "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun."

plain: Tim Alberino, a man who talks about ancient giants, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an old column in Tunisia, in North Africa. He says it carried an inscription reading, "We are the Canaanites who fled before the face of Joshua the son of Nun," referring to the people the Bible says lived in the land of Canaan before the Israelite leader Joshua conquered it. If true, it would be stone evidence, outside the Bible, of people fleeing that conquest.
